  • Holdout Forfeiture Warning: In accordance with the Owner's scope decision, 2023–2026 price concealment has been removed for this exploratory atlas.   • Accounting Integrity: Simultaneous co-releases (German Ifo Climate + Expectations; Retail Sales Headline + Core) form ONE distinct event episode and contribute exactly ONE price path to statistics (40 Ifo episodes, not 80; 49 Retail Sales episodes, not 98).
  • Descriptive Displacement Only: Cell values reflect gross close-to-entry directional displacement (%). This is NOT a win rate, TP-before-SL probability, or net profit. Zero spreads, commissions, or slippage are deducted.
  • US ISM Manufacturing PMI: Evaluated strictly as descriptive exploration, NOT as an approved trading rule.
  • Candlestick Representation: Releases inside an H1 bar are drawn with the containing bar identified; exact within-candle tick execution is not faked. All times are broker-server time.
